component.name: CachyOS Kernel Updater
component.summary: Check, compile, install, and manage CachyOS Linux kernels on Debian

description.p: Debian CachyOS Kernel Updater is a native GTK4/Libadwaita application designed to easily download, compile, install, optimize, and cryptographically sign CachyOS Linux kernels on Debian systems.

ul.li: Automated detection of latest stable CachyOS kernel releases
Native host build and isolated container build modes
Pre-configured safe cross-system defaults (localmodconfig, stripped debug symbols)
Integrated UEFI Secure Boot signing pipeline with local MOK management
Advanced hardware tuning (CPU scheduler, compiler & LTO, microarchitecture targets)
New vibrant modern CachyOS emblem logo and cohesive teal & crimson branding
Guided 1-2-3 step workflow with safe cross-system defaults
Enhanced UEFI Secure Boot signing pipeline with co-located MOK certificates
Official Debian package (.deb) and standalone Flatpak distribution
